memory.title: Memory
memory.first_run_copy: Install the PocketCtl Memory provider from the Hosts page first; your personal engineering knowledge base (search, review, claims, evidence) will appear here.
memory.enable_copy: Explicitly enable memory.search, memory.recall and memory.manage; memory.mcp stays optional.
memory.filter_scope_unavailable: Standalone scope filtering is not available yet
memory.skip_low_confidence_unavailable: Bulk skipping low-confidence candidates is not available yet
memory.review_history_unavailable: Review history is not available yet
memory.degraded_embedding: Embedding unavailable; fell back to keyword search
memory.new_claim_unavailable: Manual claim creation is not available yet
memory.no_filtered_claims: No claims match the current filter
memory.delete_warning: Physically erases the claim's content, versions, evidence and search projection, leaving only a content-free tombstone. This cannot be undone. Continue?
memory.evidence_hint: Evidence quotes source records; it is shown distinctly from generated claim text
memory.adapter_not_configured: The server has no matching model adapter configured yet
memory.extraction_confirm_copy: Extraction sends a bounded Episode Packet (goals, repository/branch/commit references, file basenames, tools, tests, approvals and bounded excerpts) to the model service above to propose review-only candidates. Token usage is recorded; cost is estimated only when explicit rates are configured.
memory.embedding_confirm_copy: Embedding sends Active Claim text to the model service above for indexing and sends query text during hybrid search. Token usage is recorded; cost is estimated only when explicit rates are configured.
memory.cost_estimate_configured: Cost estimates use explicitly configured token rates
memory.cost_estimate_unconfigured: Token usage is recorded; cost rates are not configured
memory.provider_retention_copy: PocketCtl keeps validated candidates/vectors and usage, not raw model responses. Provider processing and retention remain governed by the provider's own terms. Continue?
memory.candidate_state_changed: The candidate state changed. Refresh the list and try again.
memory.accept_failed: Could not accept the candidate. Try again later.
memory.reject_failed: Could not reject the candidate. Try again later.
memory.subtitle: Turn cross-session experience into reviewable, traceable, reversible engineering knowledge. Every conclusion keeps its versions and source evidence.
memory.module_search_copy: Search semantics, keywords, and scope together; only user-validated knowledge is returned.
memory.module_review_copy: Models can only propose candidates; accept, correct, or reject before anything enters the immutable ledger.
memory.module_claims_copy: Inspect the current claim, version history, and evidence; corrections create a version and deletion physically erases content.
memory.module_settings_copy: Automatic features start off; anything sent to a model provider requires explicit confirmation.
memory.loading_copy: Confirming installation state, service access, and index version. Empty states stay hidden until loading completes.
memory.preview_empty_copy: Search results show their real versions, evidence, and scope here.
memory.no_results_copy: Try fewer keywords or change the repository, branch, or scope.
memory.review_empty_copy: New model candidates appear here first and never become active knowledge without your approval.
memory.no_filtered_candidates: No candidates match the current filters
memory.select_claim_copy: Select a claim from search to inspect its versions, evidence, and management actions.
memory.correct_claim_copy: A correction creates a new immutable version and carries the current evidence forward.
memory.settings_modes_copy: Shadow records comparison only; Enabled can create review candidates or vector indexes.
memory.extraction_mode_copy: Send a bounded Episode Packet to create candidates that only a user can activate.
memory.embedding_mode_copy: Index Active Claims as vectors and safely fall back to keyword retrieval when unavailable.
memory.provider_disclosure_copy: The server declares model, origin, and rates; the browser never changes provider silently.
memory.service_access_copy: Users explicitly enable core services; MCP remains independently optional.
memory.service_recall_copy: Recall claims and evidence by context
memory.service_context_copy: Prepare session-bound context packs for supported managed agents
memory.service_mcp_copy: Allow trusted agents to query through read-only MCP
memory.unsaved_changes: Automatic feature modes have unsaved changes
memory.provider_boundary_copy: This change allows bounded content to leave PocketCtl's local boundary
memory.context.settingsHint: More-specific scopes can only turn the mode down; Off applies to the next not-yet-admitted turn.
memory.context.packEmpty: No context packs for this session.
memory.context.replayHint: Replay requires content input; the audit never stores query text.
memory.persona.empty: No active user-reviewed work-method claims yet.
memory.persona.title: Work-method persona
memory.persona.hint: Only from work_method claims you explicitly accepted or corrected; no behavioral inference.
memory.policy.title: Policies
memory.policy.immutableHint: Security floors live in the system layer and cannot be relaxed below it.
memory.loadout.title: Context loadouts
memory.loadout.hint: Bindings per agent/repository; pinning improves eligibility only.
memory.loadout.inertNote: Wiki/Skill entries are inert references until Phase 4/5 resolvers exist.
memory.governance.promotion.title: Propose to shared scope
memory.governance.promotion.copyBoundary: Selected sanitized excerpts become a scope-owned copy; reviewers cannot reach your personal library.
memory.governance.promotion.confirmCopy: I confirm the selected excerpts are copied in sanitized form to the target scope
memory.governance.conflict.title: Conflict resolution
memory.governance.conflict.copyBoundary: Keep parallel variants or supersede explicitly; no destructive default is preselected.
memory.governance.policy.floor: The security floor is code-owned and cannot be relaxed.
memory.governance.lifecycle.title: Confirm scope lifecycle change
memory.governance.lifecycle.consequences: This action advances the authorization fence and has immediate consequences:
memory.governance.lifecycle.freeze: Shared reads and governance mutations stop.
memory.governance.lifecycle.revoke: Existing grants and active memberships stop authorizing this scope.
